'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS Anger, Fear, Aggression''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Every Day I'm SHUFFLING'''. Username '''TacoBill'''. Line 1 Home One: War Room; start [[Anger, Fear, Aggression]] at L2 (sheet V box empty — inventory V). L8 Moth' Ecc → Hoth: Echo Base Command Center. L26 Wyron → Wioslea (V). L37 Saitam → Sai'torr Kal Fas. L41 Strike Planning (V) (sheet Strikeforce). L50–51 SATM → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. L56 WYLFM → Were You Looking For Me?.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression]]
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
